An operator's decision on an onboarding waiting in `awaiting_manual_review`. Unauthenticated today, unlike the rest of the operator surface: the route predates admin sign-in and has not been moved behind it. Treat this as a known gap rather than a design intent, and keep a network boundary in front of the engine's port.
